title: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Post-Aftermath
description: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Post-Aftermath — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Travel throughout Lower Shadow's Embrace and rough up the locals until they give up their counterfeit King's Coins. Return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy once you have a handful.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Travel throughout Lower Shadow's Embrace and rough up the locals until they give up their counterfeit King's Coins. Return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy once you have a handful.

Offer:

The rumor mill has it that K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. is getting more reports of counterfeit King's Coins being circulated throughout the Lower Shadow's Embrace.

If you wander through there and encounter any counterfeits, bring them back to me and I'll make sure they are permanently taken out of circulation!

Turn-in:

Good work getting those bogus King's Coins out of circulation. Let me know when you want to make another pass at collecting more counterfeits.

Objectives:

  • Counterfeit King's Coin ×6

Level range: 52–58
